question: **Select the most appropriate option of fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. 'actual'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the concerned line is the definition of the figure of speech 'irony' as it expresses the meaning of something not in the actual literal sense but in the opposite sense.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word is 'actual'. 
 
• 'Actual' means 'real or existing in fact.'
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

​

Correct Sentence:__ *Irony is defined as when __actual__* meaning is completely**__...__**
